reason: The proposed complete claim omits a genuine named-body lifecycle branch: EO 12149 assigns duties to the Interagency Coordinating Council and EO 12314 revokes that order and gives regional-council policy oversight to OMB before the 1982 cleanup. Numeric citation searches do not reveal these sources. Their interaction with the original general coordination commands and the absence of a surviving independent command must be explained in the frozen claim before complete acceptance. This is a completeness/reasoning rejection, not a finding that the stated whole-order end is wrong.
findings_upheld: The complete EO 12075 original contains twelve operative provisions, correctly separated in the candidate. It establishes an indefinite council; no sunset or report-triggered expiry appears. Reporting in 1-304 is a continuing duty.

EO 12148 section 5-210 adds FEMA to section 1-102; section 6 expressly makes the amendment effective July 15, 1979. It does not end the original open membership command. Its section 2-302 savings concerns section 1 transferred functions and does not preserve this council membership after revocation.

EO 12379 section 14 expressly revokes EO 12075 as amended. Its complete text has no delayed-effective clause or relevant saving. August 17, 1982 is supported as the formal revocation date, and mere preamble references to inactivity establish no earlier legal cessation.
Original 1-205 reserves existing EOP procedures; it does not create an independent post-council directive. The other administrative clauses serve this council.

All 12 original-operative quotations and all 58 quoted-parts occurrences match contiguous held text exactly. All three claim text hashes and original issue PDF fixity entries match. The claim fingerprints match the frozen assignment.

Ten supposed earlier revocation actors in the machine chain are false associations to the same full EO 12379 source. The real text identifies EO 12379 and August 17, 1982, not those earlier actor IDs or dates.

EO:12314.effect: Ends the separately conferred EO 12149 duties before EO 12379. It does not expressly revoke EO 12075. Whether any portion of EO 12075 original coordination commands was displaced must be distinguished from cessation of these later added duties.

omitted_named_body_branch.no_invented_earlier_end: I do not assign July 22, 1981 as an original-clause or whole-order end merely because the supplemental order was revoked. The broad EO 12075 mandates may continue until August 17, 1982; a corrected producer claim must explain that source-specific conclusion.

required_corrections: Read the complete held EO 12149 and EO 12314 sources listed in this review, including their signatures, all operative provisions and absence/presence of savings. Both source issue hashes have matching official fixity records.

Amend research_rationale and savings_residuals to address the EO 12149/EO 12314 branch explicitly, distinguish duties created under EO 12149 from original EO 12075 commands, and explain any partial displacement versus continued original authority. Cite those sources and exact spans in supporting_sources; record a bounded named-Council text search after examining its hits.

Record relevant supplemental/removal events in later_events where the producer concludes they affect original scopes, or explain clearly why they concern independently added duties only. Preserve the original 12-clause inventory unless substantive source review warrants a finer scope. Do not invent an earlier first_end from the 1981 date.
Refreeze the corrected claim and obtain a review of the new canonical and raw-file hashes before complete acceptance. Root must run the actual checker afterward.
